items.description:
This Absa ATM sits within Cycad Centre in Bendor Park, giving shoppers and residents a standalone cash point for everyday banking. Like other branded ATMs in the Absa network, it supports routine transactions such as cash withdrawals and balance enquiries without requiring a visit to a full-service branch, and as a standalone unit rather than a staffed branch, it is intended purely for quick self-service use.

Located at Cycad Centre on General Maritz Street in Bendor Park, Polokwane, the ATM is a convenient option for anyone running errands at the centre or passing through the surrounding neighbourhood, and it operates around the clock for after-hours access to cash.

This is a standalone Absa automated teller machine on Witklip Street in Ladanna, operated as part of Absa's wider ATM network across Polokwane. Like other Absa ATMs, it is intended for everyday banking convenience, typically supporting cash withdrawals, balance enquiries and other routine card transactions for Absa account holders and cardholders from other banks.

Standalone ATMs of this kind are usually sited for easy street access rather than full teller services, and this one in Ladanna, Polokwane, serves local residents and passing traffic who need quick access to cash. It is a straightforward, no-frills banking point rather than a full branch, suited to anyone needing a fast withdrawal or balance check.

Ackermans is a well-known South African value-fashion retailer, and this branch at Shop 4 in Mankweng Shopping Centre carries its usual mix of affordable clothing for women, men, children and babies, alongside footwear, homeware basics and cellular accessories. As part of the group's wider branch network, it follows the chain's standard approach of frequent in-store promotions and seasonal ranges aimed at budget-conscious family shoppers.

Situated in Mankweng Shopping Centre on Mankweng Street in Mankweng, Polokwane, the store is an easy stop for residents doing their everyday shopping at the centre, and it suits shoppers looking for low-priced clothing and basics for the whole family without needing to travel into central Polokwane.

AECOM SA (Pty) Ltd is the Polokwane office of AECOM, a global infrastructure consulting firm that typically provides engineering, planning, environmental and construction management services across civil, structural, mechanical and electrical disciplines. Branches of this kind generally support both public-sector infrastructure projects, such as roads, water and bulk services, and private commercial developments, working alongside municipalities, contractors and other professional consultants.

The office is based on General Beyers Street in Welgelegen, Polokwane, placing it within reach of the municipal and provincial infrastructure departments it is likely to work with. It is best suited to municipalities, developers and contractors needing professional engineering and project consulting support in the Limpopo region.

AirCare is an appliance repair service based in Flora Park, working in the same space as other local repair businesses that support households and small businesses with diagnostics and fixes for domestic appliances. Typical work for a business in this category includes refrigerator and freezer repairs, servicing of ovens and stoves, washing machines, tumble dryers, dishwashers and microwaves, along with component replacement, motor and compressor work, and electrical safety checks, often with technicians able to call on customers directly.

Based on Erasmus Street in Flora Park, Polokwane, AirCare gives households and businesses in the area a technician to assess and repair a faulty appliance rather than replace it outright.

Alexander Forbes is a well-established South African financial services group, and this Bendor office operates as part of its broader network offering insurance broking, employee benefits consulting and related financial advisory services. Offices of this kind typically assist both individual clients and businesses with short-term and life insurance needs, retirement fund administration, and broader financial planning, drawing on the group's national scale and underwriting relationships.

The office is based at the Croniel Park Building on Pierre Street in Bendor, Polokwane, making it accessible to businesses and individuals in the surrounding suburb. It is a reasonable point of contact for clients wanting insurance broking or employee benefits advice from an established, nationally recognised provider rather than a small independent broker.

Alpha Kwekery is a plant nursery operating on De Wet Drive in Bendor, in a category where businesses typically grow and sell vegetable and ornamental seedlings, potted plants, seeds, potting soil and general gardening supplies to both home gardeners and bulk buyers. Nurseries of this kind often supply seedlings for common vegetables alongside ornamental plants, and many take orders from smallholders and community gardens as well as walk-in retail customers.

Located on a plot along De Wet Drive in Bendor, Polokwane, Alpha Kwekery is a convenient stop for home gardeners and smallholders in the area looking to buy seedlings and plants, with weekday and Saturday trading hours suiting most gardening schedules.

AMM Accountants is an accounting and tax practice based in Polokwane, offering accounting, audit-related and broader business administrative support to local clients. The firm describes its approach as building long-term client relationships through quality service, and positions itself around punctual, high-quality work and youth empowerment within the local profession.

The office is located at the Dadahouse Building on Grobler Street in Polokwane, placing it within the central business district close to other professional services firms. It is a fitting choice for small businesses and individuals in and around Polokwane who want an accessible, locally based accountant for day-to-day bookkeeping, tax and administrative needs.

Applebox Accounting is a small accounting and tax practice based in Bendor, in a category where local firms of this kind typically handle bookkeeping, tax returns, payroll administration and general financial advice for small businesses and individual clients. This sort of practice generally covers the day-to-day administrative and compliance work that keeps a small business's finances in order, from monthly bookkeeping through to annual tax submissions.

Based on Dr Moolman Drive in Bendor, Polokwane, Applebox Accounting suits business owners and individuals nearby who would rather deal with a local, personal accounting service than a large national firm, with set weekday hours for routine appointments and consultations.

Aqua Fella is a purified water and ice supplier based in Ladanna, offering purified water refills, bottled and dispenser water, purified ice and fruit juices, with custom branding also available on bottles for business customers. The water passes through a five-stage reverse osmosis filtration system before bottling, reflecting a focus on treated drinking water for households and offices rather than general retail goods, and the refill model lets regular customers bring back empty bottles and dispensers instead of buying a new container every visit.

Based on Witklip Street in Ladanna, Polokwane, Aqua Fella is geared toward households, offices and businesses needing a reliable local supplier of purified water and ice, including refill and dispenser options for ongoing use, walk-in customers topping up during the week, and businesses wanting branded bottles for functions or everyday supply.

Bomat Security Service is a security company serving homes and businesses around Polokwane, offering the range of services typical of a local armed-response provider. Its work generally covers alarm monitoring and armed response, CCTV camera installation and maintenance, electric fencing and access control, plus gate motor and automation installs and repairs, with reaction officers dispatched once an alarm has been triggered and technicians called out to fix faults on equipment already in place at a property.

Based on Limpopo Avenue in Penina Park, Polokwane, the company serves residential and commercial clients across the surrounding suburbs, making it a fit for property owners wanting one local provider to handle both the security hardware and the ongoing monitoring that goes with it.

Caffe Rossini is an Italian-style café whose concept and name are built around a 19th-century Italian opera composer whose love of music was matched only by his love of good coffee and good food. The menu follows authentic Italian coffee-making traditions while catering to local tastes, running from egg-and-bacon breakfasts and light lunches through to Italian-style sandwiches, paninis, fresh salads and pastas, finished off with a slice of cake alongside another espresso or cappuccino for those with time to linger.

The café trades from Savannah Mall in Fauna Park, Polokwane, making it a convenient stop for shoppers and locals after a sit-down coffee or a casual lunch while out at the mall.

CJ Makelaars is an independent, authorised financial services provider based in Bendor, Polokwane, advising clients on short-term and life insurance cover. The brokerage places emphasis on personal, one-on-one attention to each client's insurance needs, drawing on years of industry experience to recommend suitable risk cover and financial planning, and carries a wide enough range of products across insurers that clients need not go without cover for their homes, vehicles or businesses.

From its Bendor Drive office, the brokerage serves individuals and businesses across Polokwane, suiting clients who want straightforward, ongoing advice on their insurance rather than a single once-off sale.

Deep Blue Accountants is an accounting and bookkeeping practice serving individuals and small businesses in and around Fauna Park, Polokwane. Practices of this kind typically handle the day-to-day work of bookkeeping and management accounts, VAT and tax return preparation, payroll processing and annual financial statements, along with general guidance on compliance and record-keeping for sole proprietors, partnerships and registered companies that would rather not manage their own books.

Operating from Gazelle Street in Fauna Park, the practice is suited to small and medium businesses that want a local accountant handling routine bookkeeping and tax compliance rather than a large national firm.

This Bendor address houses a general medical practice offering everyday healthcare consultations to the local community. A general practice like this typically handles routine check-ups, diagnosis and treatment of common illnesses, management of ongoing chronic conditions such as diabetes or high blood pressure, referrals to specialists when needed, and basic procedures such as wound care and vaccinations, acting as a first point of contact for patients needing medical attention rather than a visit to a hospital emergency department.

The practice is located on Bendor Drive in Bendor, Polokwane, giving residents of the surrounding suburbs a nearby, accessible option for general and family healthcare.

This Hospital Park address is home to an ophthalmology practice offering eye care to patients in and around Polokwane. Ophthalmology practices typically combine eye examinations and vision testing with the diagnosis and treatment of conditions such as cataracts and glaucoma, alongside surgical procedures ranging from cataract removal to laser eye treatment and other retinal work, for patients referred by GPs or optometrists as well as those booking an appointment directly with the practice.

Situated at the corner of Plein and Devenish Street in Hospital Park, Polokwane, the practice is a reference point in the city for patients needing specialist eye care beyond routine optometry.

This Hospital Park practice is a urology clinic treating conditions of the urinary tract and male reproductive system. Urology practices of this kind generally manage issues such as kidney stones, prostate conditions, bladder problems, urinary infections and sexual dysfunction, drawing on investigations and procedures carried out at an affiliated hospital when surgery or further specialist assessment is needed beyond what a single consultation alone can address, often alongside ultrasound or other diagnostic imaging.

Based on Compensatie Street in Hospital Park, Polokwane, the clinic sees patients referred by general practitioners as well as those seeking a specialist opinion on a urological concern of their own.

Dux Consulting Engineers is a civil engineering consultancy serving clients across Polokwane and the surrounding area. A consultancy offering this kind of service typically provides civil engineering design and town planning input for residential, commercial and infrastructure projects, covering work such as stormwater and sewer design, roads and earthworks, site services and liaison with municipal authorities through the planning, approval and construction stages of a development, from early design through to on-site completion.

The consultancy operates from Harvey Street in Eduan Park, Polokwane, and suits developers, municipalities and property owners who need qualified, locally based engineering input on a build or subdivision rather than bringing in a firm from out of town.

Ebony Insurance Brokers is a short-term and life insurance brokerage operating out of Polokwane Central. Brokerages of this kind act as an intermediary between clients and insurance underwriters, comparing cover and premiums across several providers to arrange policies for vehicles, homes, businesses and personal life cover, and helping clients with renewals, policy amendments and the claims process once a policy has been put in place and needs to be maintained.

The brokerage is based at Ebony House on Landros Mare Street in Polokwane Central, suiting individuals and businesses who want independent, cross-insurer advice on their cover rather than dealing with a single provider.

EMB Makelaars, trading as Marianne Makelaars, is an insurance brokerage operating from Hospital Park. Independent brokerages such as this typically advise on life, short-term and long-term insurance cover, sourcing policies from a range of underwriters to match each client's circumstances, and assisting with estate planning matters such as wills and the structuring of life cover for a client's dependants over the years as circumstances change.

The brokerage is based on Devenish Street in Hospital Park, Polokwane, and is suited to individuals and families looking for personal, ongoing guidance on their insurance and estate planning rather than a single transaction handled once and then left untouched.

Faunapark Post Office is a branch of the South African Post Office (SAPO), offering standard counter services that include posting and collecting mail and parcels, bill and account payments, postage and stationery sales, and motor vehicle licence renewals. Classified as a nodal branch, it runs multiple built-in service counters together with internet-enabled counters, putting it among the more comprehensively equipped SAPO outlets serving the northern side of Polokwane.

The branch trades from Shop G20 inside Savannah Mall on the corner of Grimm Street and McDonald Avenue, Fauna Park, and has operated from this site since 2009. It remains a convenient stop for mall shoppers and nearby residents needing postal, parcel or licensing matters handled during a single visit.

Favour Guest House is a self-catering guest house set around tranquil garden surroundings, with a set of ground-floor rooms each fitted with a kitchenette, a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, and sound-proofing for a quieter stay. Every room includes a work desk, refrigerator, microwave, electric kettle and free toiletries, and guests have access to free WiFi across the property.

The guest house is located on Limpopo Avenue in Penina Park, Polokwane, within reach of the N1 and the city centre. Its self-contained, ground-floor units and quiet garden setting make it a practical choice for road-trippers, business travellers and anyone wanting independent, home-like accommodation rather than a full-service hotel stay.

FNB ATM Cycad Centre is a standalone automated teller machine operated by First National Bank, providing self-service cash withdrawals, balance enquiries and other everyday transactions such as airtime and prepaid electricity purchases that FNB's ATM network typically supports. It is an ATM-only point rather than a staffed branch, so no counter or consultation services are offered on site.

The machine is positioned at Cycad Centre on Outspan Drive in Bendor Ext 59, Bendor Park, Polokwane, within a small cluster of other ATMs in the immediate area. It is a practical option for bank customers needing quick cash access while running errands nearby, with service available around the clock.

FNB Platinum Park is a branch of First National Bank, one of South Africa's major retail banks, offering everyday counter and consultation services such as deposits and withdrawals, card and account queries, loan and insurance enquiries, and foreign exchange. Like other FNB branches, it gives walk-in customers and small businesses a staffed point of contact alongside the bank's digital and app-based banking channels.

The branch operates from Shop 3 in Platinum Park Shopping Centre on Outspan Drive, Bendor Park, Polokwane, serving residents and businesses in the surrounding suburb. It suits customers who prefer face-to-face banking or need services such as cash handling that cannot be completed online.

Furniture Mart Baobab is a furniture and homeware store trading under the Furniture Mart banner, a South African retail chain known for household furniture ranges spanning lounge suites, bedroom sets, dining furniture and related home accessories. Branches typically also stock appliances and offer in-store credit or layby facilities, letting customers furnish a home in a single visit rather than shopping around multiple suppliers.

This branch trades from Clivicola Street in Baobab Gardens, Thornhill Estate, Polokwane. It is a convenient option for households and tenants in the surrounding suburb looking to furnish a home or replace existing pieces without travelling into the city centre.

Furnmart Polokwane is a branch of Furnmart, a long-standing South African furniture and appliance retailer. The store's range spans furniture, household appliances, electronics and outdoor and leisure products, with combo deals that bundle furniture and appliance purchases together. The chain offers in-store credit facilities along with a standard returns and refunds policy, letting customers furnish a home or replace appliances without needing cash upfront.

The branch trades from Landdros Mare Street in Polokwane Central. It is a practical stop for shoppers wanting lounge, dining and bedroom furniture together with major and small appliances under one roof in the city centre.

GreyTow Salon is a hair salon specialising in braiding, including knotless braids and other protective installations, alongside general hair styling, treatments and finishing for everyday wear and special occasions. The salon also styles children's hair, runs its bookings strictly by appointment taken through WhatsApp, and keeps a steady following on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, where it posts its pricelist, available styles and finished looks for clients to browse before booking a slot.

It operates from University Road in Mankweng, near Turfloop's Gate 2 behind the Shoprite Centre, closed on Mondays and open the rest of the week. The salon is a popular choice for students and residents around the University of Limpopo looking for braiding and styling appointments close to campus without having to travel further into Polokwane.

Hillpet Construction Management is a building and construction company that manages building projects on behalf of clients, a role that typically covers planning and budgeting, drawing up a construction programme, coordinating contractors, tradespeople and suppliers, and overseeing a project through to completion and handover. Construction management firms of this kind act as the client's representative on site, aiming to keep projects on schedule and within budget while handling the day-to-day decisions that come up during a build.

The company is based on Pietersburg Street in Ladanna, Polokwane, and takes on work across the wider city. It suits property owners and developers in the area who need a dedicated project manager to oversee a residential or commercial build rather than contracting and supervising each trade directly themselves.

Hopewell Medical Centre is registered as a general practice, providing the day-to-day medical care a GP practice typically covers: consultations for illness and injury, chronic condition management for conditions such as diabetes and hypertension, health checks, vaccinations, basic wound care, and referrals to specialists or hospitals when further treatment is needed. As with most general practices, patients can expect ongoing, family-oriented care that follows them over time rather than care limited to a single specialty or a single visit.

The practice is located on Thabo Mbeki Street in Fauna Park, Polokwane. It serves as a local point of care for residents in the surrounding suburb needing routine GP consultations and ongoing health management close to home, without having to travel further into the city for everyday medical attention.

Jet is a national fashion retail chain, and this Mall@Lebo branch stocks clothing, footwear and homeware for men, women, teens, kids and babies, along with the cellular products and accessories typical of Jet stores. As part of a well-known South African retail group, the branch offers family fashion shopping backed by the chain's regular seasonal promotions, store cards and in-store financing options that let shoppers spread the cost of larger purchases over time.

The store trades from Shop 31 in Mall@Lebo, on the corner of the R518 and R579 in Lebowakgomo. It is a convenient fashion stop for shoppers in Lebowakgomo and the surrounding villages doing a family wardrobe shop in one trip rather than travelling into Polokwane.

JR Electrical is an electrical contracting business operating out of Polokwane Central, taking on the kind of installation, maintenance and repair work typical of an independent electrician. This generally covers distribution board upgrades, rewiring, lighting and socket installations, fault-finding, and the issuing of compliance certificates (COCs) for change of ownership or occupation. Call-outs of this kind usually serve both household clients and small commercial premises that need wiring faults fixed or new circuits added without delay.

The workshop operates from Jorissen Street in Polokwane Central, close to the city's commercial core, making it a convenient option for homeowners, landlords and local businesses that need an electrician for everyday wiring work, repairs or compliance sign-off.

JSC Khoza Attorneys Inc is a law firm based in Bendor, Polokwane, operating in the way most small to mid-sized South African legal practices do. Firms of this kind typically handle a mix of civil and commercial work, which can include property transfers and conveyancing, deceased estate administration, road accident fund claims, and general litigation or advisory work for individuals and businesses.

The practice is located on Pierre Street in Bendor, a short distance from Polokwane's central business area. It is the kind of firm clients turn to for day-to-day legal matters rather than only large corporate work, offering a local point of contact for property, estate and personal legal needs.

Kabmed Centre for Ophthalmology is an eye-care practice in Hospital Park, Polokwane, providing the kind of specialist services associated with an ophthalmology practice. This typically includes comprehensive eye examinations, diagnosis and management of conditions such as cataracts, glaucoma and diabetic eye disease, minor procedures, and referral pathways for patients who need surgical treatment or further specialist care.

The practice is based on Burger Street in Hospital Park, an area associated with several of Polokwane's medical facilities. It is suited to patients needing a dedicated eye specialist rather than a general optometrist, including those managing ongoing eye conditions that require regular monitoring.

Khutso Bookshop is a bookshop and stationery outlet in Polokwane Central, listed under books, children's books and management books in local business directories. Alongside its book range, the shop stocks general stationery supplies, serving students, office workers and families shopping for reading material and everyday school or office essentials. The mix of titles, from children's reading to management and business books, points to a shop that caters to a broad range of customers rather than a single niche.

The shop trades from Gen Joubert Street in Polokwane Central, within the city's main retail area. It is a useful stop for shoppers looking for a neighbourhood bookseller rather than a large chain store, particularly for children's titles, business and management reading, and stationery top-ups.

Lafixa IT Solutions is a computer repair and IT support workshop in Nirvana, Polokwane, doing the kind of hands-on work typical of an independent PC repair shop. This usually covers diagnosing and fixing hardware faults, replacing components such as screens, batteries and drives, software troubleshooting, virus and malware removal, and basic network or printer setup for home and small-business clients.

The workshop operates from Bombay Street in Nirvana. It is the sort of business households and small offices rely on for affordable laptop and desktop repairs and upgrades, rather than sending devices back to a manufacturer or a large retail chain.

Legend Panelbeaters is a panel beating and vehicle body repair workshop in Ladanna, Polokwane, carrying out the collision and bodywork repairs typical of this trade. Work of this kind usually includes straightening and repairing damaged panels, dent removal, replacement of damaged body parts, and spray painting and respraying to restore a vehicle's finish after an accident or general wear.

The workshop is based on Platinum Street in Ladanna. It is the kind of business motorists turn to after a collision or for cosmetic bodywork and paint repairs, often working alongside insurance assessors to get a damaged vehicle back on the road.

LIMCOAT Sandblasting and Powder Coating is an industrial surface-treatment business in Futura, Polokwane, offering the kind of work typical of a sandblasting and powder coating operation. This generally involves abrasive blasting to strip rust, old paint and scale from metal components, followed by the application of a powder coating finish that is baked on for a durable, corrosion-resistant surface.

The workshop is located on Chroom Street in Futura. Businesses of this type usually serve engineering workshops, fabricators, and owners of agricultural, automotive or structural steel components that need to be stripped back and refinished before being put back into service.

Mafokoane AL Optometrist is an optometry practice in Ladanna, Polokwane, providing the core services expected of a registered optometrist. This typically includes eye examinations and vision testing, prescribing and dispensing spectacles, fitting frames and lenses, and contact lens fittings, with referral to an ophthalmologist when a patient needs further specialist or surgical care. Practices of this kind usually keep a range of frames on hand so patients can be examined and fitted in one visit.

The practice is on the first floor of the Tropicana Centre on Bulawayo Street in Ladanna. It offers a convenient option for residents in the area needing routine eye tests, new glasses or contact lenses without travelling to a larger optometry chain elsewhere in Polokwane.

Maloka Thulare Attorneys is a law firm in Polokwane Central, operating as a general practice in the way most independent South African attorneys' firms do. This usually means handling a broad spread of legal work, from family law matters such as divorce, to property transfers and conveyancing, road accident fund claims, commercial contracts, and disputes over land or deceased estates.

The firm is based on Hans van Rensburg Street in Polokwane Central, close to the city's legal and administrative precinct. It suits clients who want a single firm to handle varied personal or business legal matters rather than approaching a different specialist for each one.

Mamashela Funeral Directors & Tombstone is a funeral home in Polokwane Central, providing the kind of services typical of an undertaker and memorial business. This usually includes arranging burials and cremations, body preparation and collection, funeral planning and coordination on the day, casket selection, and, as its name suggests, tombstone and memorial masonry for grieving families. Operations of this kind are generally reachable at any hour, since a death can occur at any time and families need to be collected and cared for without delay.

The funeral home operates from Market Street in Polokwane Central. It serves families across the city at one of the most difficult times, combining funeral arrangement with memorial and tombstone work under one roof rather than requiring separate providers.

Marakalala Transport is an independent transport and logistics operator serving Polokwane and the surrounding Limpopo region. Operators of this kind typically arrange the movement of goods, furniture and household effects between properties, combining load transport with furniture removals and scheduled deliveries. The service is generally aimed at private customers relocating home or office contents, as well as smaller businesses that need dependable transport without committing to a large national freight contract.

The business operates from Mokgapa Street in Flora Park, on the northern side of Polokwane, making it convenient for clients across the city and surrounding towns. It suits anyone needing a straightforward, locally based transport option for moving goods or furniture.

Max Hydraulics is a hydraulics engineering supplier based in the Futura industrial area of Polokwane. Businesses of this type typically supply, repair and fit hydraulic components such as hoses, cylinders, rams and pumps, often built or configured to a customer's specific application. This kind of workshop generally serves industries that depend on hydraulic systems for lifting, pressing and moving heavy loads, including agriculture, construction, mining and transport operators.

The business trades from Koper Street in Futura, operating weekday mornings and afternoons. It is a practical option for operators needing hydraulic parts sourced, assembled or repaired close to home rather than shipped in from further afield.

Moseki Function Hire & Catering is an event decor, catering and function hire company based in Polokwane Central. Businesses in this line of work typically supply tents, chairs, tables, linen and table settings alongside catering and on-site food service, covering weddings, funerals, birthday parties, year-end functions and corporate events. Many also assist with basic event coordination, helping clients plan the layout, decor and catering for the day.

The company operates from Rissik Street in Polokwane Central, serving clients across the city and surrounding towns. It suits clients who prefer their decor, seating and catering arranged through one local company rather than booking several separate suppliers.

MV Studio is a beauty studio in Welgelegen specialising in permanent makeup and cosmetic tattooing. Studios of this kind generally offer treatments such as microblading and lip blush, which deposit semi-permanent pigment to define brows and lips, alongside more conventional beauty services including hair removal, facials and bridal makeup for clients preparing for weddings and other special occasions. Appointments typically run longer than a standard beauty treatment, since cosmetic tattooing needs careful consultation and precise, steady work.

The studio is based on Genl Kemp Street in Welgelegen, within easy reach of Polokwane's southern suburbs, with its own weekday and Saturday trading hours. It suits clients looking for longer-lasting cosmetic treatments as well as regular facials and grooming appointments closer to home.

Nedbank ATM Bok & Excelsior is a standalone Nedbank cash machine positioned on a street corner in Polokwane Central. Machines like this one are generally there for straightforward self-service banking: withdrawing cash, checking an account balance and buying prepaid airtime or electricity, usable by Nedbank clients and most other bank cardholders thanks to the shared national ATM network. As a street-side unit rather than a branch, it carries no teller or consultation services, just a card slot and a cash dispenser for a quick transaction.

It stands at the corner of Bok and Excelsior Street in the heart of the CBD and operates around the clock. It offers pedestrians and shoppers moving through the city centre a quick stop for cash without needing to enter a branch or queue at a counter.

Nedbank ATM Cycad Centre is a self-service Nedbank cash machine inside a small retail centre in Bendor Park. As with other Nedbank ATMs, it lets customers draw cash, confirm balances and settle small prepaid purchases, such as airtime or electricity, on the spot, saving a trip to a full branch for routine banking that doesn't need a teller. It sits alongside the other shops at the centre rather than as a stand-alone unit on the street.

The machine is located at Shop 4 in Cycad Centre, on the corner of Outspan Drive and General Maritz Street, and is accessible at any hour. It is a handy option for shoppers and residents already busy with errands at the centre who need cash before moving on to the next stop.

Nedbank ATM Engen Ladanna is a Nedbank cash machine installed at an Engen filling station on the Ladanna and Annadale boundary. Forecourt ATMs of this kind typically give motorists a place to get cash or check an account balance alongside fuelling up and visiting the station's convenience store, and are generally used for quick, small transactions rather than anything requiring a teller. Being attached to a filling station also means the surrounding forecourt tends to be busier and better lit after dark than a stand-alone street ATM.

The ATM is sited on Witklip Street, making it an easy detour for drivers passing through day or night. It suits anyone needing quick access to cash while filling up rather than travelling into the city centre for the same errand.

Palms Inn is a guesthouse in Dalmada offering 37 individually decorated en-suite rooms, each fitted with M-Net television and tea and coffee facilities. Guesthouses of this size typically cater to both business travellers and tourists passing through Polokwane, with enough rooms to comfortably host a small group or conference booking alongside individual guests, and standard check-in from 2pm and check-out at 10am to allow housekeeping time to turn rooms around between stays.

The property is situated on Plot 53 in Dalmada on the edge of Polokwane, offering a quieter, more private alternative to hotel accommodation in the city centre. It suits travellers wanting comfortable, self-contained rooms for an overnight stay or longer, whether passing through on the N1 or visiting the city on business.

Paris Supermarket & Cafe is a neighbourhood supermarket and grocery store on Witklip Street in Annadale. Stores of this kind typically stock everyday groceries, fresh fruit and vegetables, bread, dairy and household basics, with the attached cafe element generally offering a small counter for quick snacks, cooldrinks or takeaway food alongside the grocery shopping, so customers can grab something to eat on the way out rather than making a separate stop.

The store serves the local Annadale community with extended daily trading hours, opening early and closing late every day including Sunday. It is a practical, everyday stop for residents doing a quick grocery run or picking up a takeaway bite rather than a full weekly shop.

PEP is South Africa's largest single-brand retailer, founded in 1965 and now part of the Pepkor group. Its stores sell affordable clothing, footwear and homeware for the whole family, along with everyday items such as cellular products, airtime, basic electrical goods and household essentials, aimed at value-conscious shoppers across the country rather than a particular age group or budget tier. The format relies on high turnover of low-priced stock, so ranges change often and promotions run regularly through the year.

This branch trades inside Mall of the North in Bendor, Polokwane, alongside the centre's other retail and convenience stores. It is a reliable stop for budget-friendly clothing and household essentials while shopping at the mall, suiting families doing a cost-conscious top-up shop.
